title: A simple yet effective approach for predicting disease spread using mathematically-inspired diffusion-informed neural networks.
summary: A hybrid neural differential-equation/GCN model predicts COVID-19 incidence across Spanish regions from observed time series and is compared with six baselines on held-out periods. This is a specific epidemiological forecasting result, not causal or prospective outbreak validation.
